mapper.select: SELECT MAX(in_no) FROM purchase_in WHERE in_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
SELECT pii.sku_id AS skuId, SUM(pii.qty) AS qty FROM purchase_in pi INNER JOIN purchase_in_item pii ON pi.id = pii.in_id WHERE pi.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND pi.status = 1 GROUP BY pii.sku_id

SELECT pi.id, pi.in_no AS inNo, pi.purchase_id AS purchaseId, pi.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, pi.total_qty AS totalQty, pi.status, pi.create_user_id AS createUserId, pi.audit_user_id AS auditUserId, pi.create_time AS createTime, pi.remark,
po.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName
FROM purchase_in pi LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pi.purchase_id = po.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON pi.warehouse_id = w.id
WHERE 1=1
AND pi.in_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.inNo}, '%')
AND po.purchase_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.purchaseNo}, '%')
AND pi.warehouse_id = #{dto.warehouseId}
AND pi.status = #{dto.status}
ORDER BY pi.create_time DESC

SELECT pi.id, pi.in_no AS inNo, pi.purchase_id AS purchaseId, po.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, pi.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, pi.total_qty AS totalQty, pi.status, pi.create_user_id AS createUserId, pi.audit_user_id AS auditUserId, DATE_FORMAT(pi.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, pi.remark FROM purchase_in pi LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pi.purchase_id = po.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON pi.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE pi.id = #{inId}
